description: The done-gate in the agent loop, where it runs and what interrupts it (plan task pod-23, docs/PROOF-GATE.md): plan mode, a stop, a step limit, a queued message, the next run, a deleted conversation, the trust list a second chat is handed, an acceptance file that Git ignores (lib/agent.mjs, lib/manager.mjs, lib/concurrent-api-agent.mjs, lib/proof/gate.mjs). Each mutation runs the whole suite (about 40 s).

mutations.name: GA-queued-ignored
mutations.what: a message queued while the checks ran does not stop the judgment

mutations.name: GA-kept-over-runs
mutations.what: the judgment of the last run stands in the next one

mutations.name: GA-plan-mode
mutations.what: a task in plan mode is gated

mutations.name: GA-no-stop
mutations.what: a stop does not reach the checks

mutations.name: GA-no-budget
mutations.what: the agent is sent back when no turn is left

mutations.name: GA-no-forget
mutations.what: a deleted conversation leaves its baseline

mutations.name: GA-own-trust
mutations.what: a second chat reads the trust list of its own data folder

mutations.name: GA-trust-other
mutations.what: the manager ignores the list it was handed

mutations.name: GA-baseline-own-acceptance
mutations.what: the baseline's own acceptance file is compared

patches.old: const before = withAcceptance(await baselineSide({ loaded, hubDir, root, env, scratch: path.join(scratch, 'store'), signal }), acceptance, objectFormat);
patches.new: const before = await baselineSide({ loaded, hubDir, root, env, scratch: path.join(scratch, 'store'), signal });

mutations.name: GA-final-own-acceptance
mutations.what: the workspace's listing decides about the acceptance file

patches.old: const after = withAcceptance(await workTreeSide({ root, stateDir: path.join(scratch, 'final'), env, signal }), current, objectFormat);
patches.new: const after = await workTreeSide({ root, stateDir: path.join(scratch, 'final'), env, signal });

mutations.name: GA-autocrlf-ungated
mutations.what: a second chat whose worktree has other line ends than the trusted file is not gated

mutations.name: GA-autocrlf-edit
mutations.what: the line ends of a second chat's worktree are an edit

patches.old: const current = sameButLineEnds(found, run.acceptance) ? run.acceptance : found;
